## Activity

West Gate Eye Clinic completed activity during October 2021, with 359 captures recorded for the month. The activity provides the basis for the image-quality review and subsequent grading outcomes. The recorded volume should be considered alongside the number of images that could not be assessed and the time taken to complete grading.

## Image quality

Of the 359 captures, 14 were marked ungradable. This represents an ungradable rate of 3.9 per cent. These images could not be used for grading and are included in the monthly image-quality measure. The result should continue to be monitored as part of routine site operations and quality assurance.

## Grading

The grading outcome recorded 79 referable results. The median lag for grading was 4. Together, these measures describe the volume requiring referral and the time between image capture and completion of grading. The figures provide a summary of the site’s performance for October 2021 and support ongoing review of service activity, image quality and grading timeliness.
